description: solposx is a Python package with reference implementations of solar-position and atmospheric-refraction algorithms. The JOSS paper reports 11 position algorithms and six refraction models, and the own repository provides a common interface for comparing their outputs. Spatial coverage is a user-specified site and temporal coverage is the requested date or series. The repository states BSD-3-Clause. Solar angles can be used as inputs to photovoltaic yield, shading or solar-thermal infrastructure simulations. Comparing methods can also expose numerical differences when model results are sensitive to sun position. A caveat is that solar position is only geometry: cloud, aerosols, terrain, panels and system losses require separate inputs or models. A reference calculation does not validate generation at a plant. No directly related catalogue record was established. The article and own README were read without evaluating an algorithm.
